audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text says Static Field bursts her 'Cozy Campfire shield' — Cozy Campfire (W) is the healing zone, not a shield. The shield ability is Warm Hugs (E). breakdown.cooldowns also carries no real numbers despite the packet flagging a total absence of cooldown-sequencing advice.
audit.why: enemyKit confirms W = 'Cozy Campfire' (heal/range zone, no shield flag) and E = 'Warm Hugs' (carries the shield flag) — the page names the wrong ability for the shield your R strips.

edits.before: Your R Static Field bursts her Cozy Campfire shield and silences on the outer wave; time your all-in as her ult Breath of Life comes off so she can't cleanse a CC-chain with the tenacity/heal, and you still out-engage her the moment she has no ult up.
edits.after: Your R Static Field bursts her Warm Hugs shield and silences on the outer wave; time your all-in as her ult Breath of Life comes off so she can't cleanse a CC-chain with the tenacity/heal, and you still out-engage her the moment she has no ult up.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Power Fist doubles your auto and pops her target airborne — her only answer is a 10s-cooldown Q knockback, not a stun, so the grab-into-fist chain still lands clean.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Cozy Campfire heals and extends range on a 29-21s cooldown — chip damage inside its zone just refunds itself, so back off until it's down.

edits.before: - Milio Breath of Life: matchup-defining — The team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain — force it early, engage after. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Overdrive answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Breath of Life (R) is down 160s at rank 1, 130s at rank 3 — force fights while it's on cooldown. - Warm Hugs (E) shields off 2 charges; bait one before you commit the grab. - Your Rocket Grab resets in 20-16s — don't overextend chasing a whiffed hook.
